They sing a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the…

translations.web: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
translations.bsb: And he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using.
translations.kjv: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
translations.asv: And he measured the wall thereof, a hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
